_what: Settings for the CogVideoX arms of the panel-cover experiment.
_frozen: Frozen before any arm was generated. Prompts are per case and per arm.

base_edit.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, warped geometry, duplicated objects, flicker, text, watermark
base_edit._why_strength: 0.6 is the strength at which this project's earlier prompt-only edits actually changed scene content. A weaker pass cannot be read as a fair test of whether a prompt alone can close a panel.
base_edit._executed_steps: strength truncates the schedule, so 50 requested steps execute 30.

refined.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, warped geometry, duplicated objects, flicker, text, watermark
refined._why_strength: 0.2 matches the manual-path experiment, where it preserved an existing composited intervention instead of undoing it. The panel is already closed in the composite; this pass is asked only to make it look like footage.
refined._executed_steps: strength truncates the schedule, so 50 requested steps execute 10.

_prompts_note: Frozen 2026-11-05 with the cases. One prompt per arm, identical across the three cases, because the three cases show the same machine from the same camera and a per-case prompt would be a free parameter tuned per result. The base_edit prompt names the scene and the intended door state and nothing else: it never calls the scene safe, never names a class, and never describes a closing action, because no closing action is generated.
